image_description: The image displays two black firearms mounted on a white pegboard wall. The top firearm appears to be a submachine gun (resembling an MP5) with a folding stock and vertical foregrip. The bottom firearm is a larger assault rifle (resembling an AK-variant or similar) with a fixed stock, curved magazine, and carrying handle. Both have matte black finishes. Accessories and tools hang on the pegboard, including a knife-like object with a red label.
